A technique to improve visual fidelity and performance by pre-calculating shadow and ambient occlusion data into the volume texture, leveraging the static nature of the cloud volume.
It involves pre-marching a shadow ray through the volume (e.g., 4 shadow samples per cloud sample) and pre-marching ambient occlusion into the volume texture.
The techniques described are derived from practical implementations of ray marching in real-time graphics, particularly in the context of SDF rendering and volumetric clouds.
